queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*)::numeric AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.order_count) AS average_count_above_average, AVG(c.order_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM counts c CROSS JOIN overall a WHERE c.order_count > a.average_count

WITH types(ordertune) AS (VALUES ('Stop'), ('Market'), ('Limit'), ('StopLimit')), counts AS (SELECT t.ordertune, COUNT(o.orderspivot)::numeric AS order_count FROM types t LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.ordertune = t.ordertune AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY t.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.order_count) AS average_count_above_average, AVG(c.order_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM counts c CROSS JOIN overall a WHERE c.order_count > a.average_count

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o."ordertune", COUNT(DISTINCT o."orderspivot") AS order_count FROM "orders" AS o JOIN "riskandmargin" AS r ON r."ordervault" = o."recordvault" GROUP BY o."ordertune"), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.order_count * 1.0) AS average_count, AVG(tc.order_count - overall.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.order_count > overall.average_count

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o."ordertune", COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM "orders" AS o JOIN "riskandmargin" AS r ON r."ordervault" = o."recordvault" GROUP BY o."ordertune"), overall AS (SELECT AVG(match_count * 1.0) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.match_count * 1.0) AS average_count, AVG(tc.match_count - overall.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.match_count > overall.average_count

WITH order_types AS (SELECT 'Stop' AS ordertune UNION ALL SELECT 'Market' UNION ALL SELECT 'Limit' UNION ALL SELECT 'StopLimit'), type_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o."orderspivot") AS order_count FROM order_types AS t LEFT JOIN "orders" AS o ON o."ordertune" = t.ordertune AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "riskandmargin" AS r WHERE r."ordervault" = o."recordvault") GROUP BY t.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.order_count * 1.0) AS average_count, AVG(tc.order_count - overall.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.order_count > overall.average_count

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.order_count) AS average_count_above_baseline, AVG(tc.order_count - b.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE tc.order_count > b.average_count;
